instruction: Follow all the edm artists on Spotify that have at least 23 followers.
notes: The set of EDM artists with >= 23 followers is only known at runtime, so three placeholder artists (artist-1..3) stand for the search results; the follow step is repeated once per actual result. They are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can list every goal condition. spotify.search_artists needs no token; it is called with query="EDM", genre="EDM", min_follower_count=23 (paginating page_index until empty), and its effect (matching-artists-found) unlocks following any artist flagged by the static (matches-criteria ?x) facts, mirroring the genre/follower filter. Username comes from supervisor.show_profile (email), password from supervisor.show_account_passwords. No answer is needed, so complete_task takes no parameters. Only spotify.UserArtistFollowing records change, and nothing is unfollowed.
